title: 第一卷 第19章 人族无大帝，九大圣体战苍穹！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
没过多久，沐凝薇被带到了姜家祖地。

    她一脸茫然的望着面前的五座神源山，嘴角还沾着糕点的碎屑。

    “姜无痕，你让人带我来这里做什么？该不会是想把我骗到这没人的地方，再狠狠地欺负我吧？”沐凝薇皱着小眉头，一脸警惕道，“我警告你，如果娘亲找不见我，一定会跟你要人的！”

    “闭嘴，快拜见我族老祖！”

    姜无痕提醒道。

    “老祖？”沐凝薇环顾四周，疑惑道，“这里除了我们，哪有人啊？”

    “小无痕，这丫头……能行吗？怎么感觉脑袋不太灵光的模样？”三祖疑惑，担忧道，“可别浪费了那一枚元圣丹！”

    “诶？石头说话了！”沐凝薇吓了一跳，转身就想走，“这到底是什么鬼地方，该不会闹鬼吧？”

    “沐凝薇！”姜无痕瞪了她一眼，沉声道，“这里沉睡的，是我姜家的五位老祖，你给我放尊重点！不然，就算告诉你娘亲，她也要跟我一起教训你！”

    “你，你，你……你别吓唬我啊，我娘亲才不会教训我呢！”沐凝薇虽依旧嘴硬，却乖巧的站在了姜无痕身边，“你别那么凶好不好？我听你的就是了。”

    “这还差不多！”

    姜无痕取出元圣丹递给她，嘱咐道：“含在嘴里，听我命令再咽下去！”

    “哦。”

    沐凝薇听话照做，将元圣丹放入口中。

    姜无痕看向五位老祖，始祖开口道：“开始吧……”

    “咽下去！”

    姜无痕一声令下，沐凝薇将元圣丹吞了下去。

    下一刻，一股恐怖的力量，在她体内爆发。

    强悍霸道的力量，游走于她的四肢百骸，为其洗筋易髓。

    她是为战而生的先天战体，升华的过程，自然比其他神体要狂暴许多。

    “姜无痕，你这个大骗子，你又骗我……”沐凝薇跪在地上痛苦挣扎，声音嘶哑，“好难受，好痛苦……”

    姜无痕在旁边看着，并未插手。

    他心里清楚，这时候没人能帮她，只能靠她自己撑过去。

    大概十息之后，痛苦渐渐消退，取而代之的是一种难以言喻的舒爽。

    她的身上浮现出道道白光，体内血液流动，竟发出阵阵如惊涛骇浪般的轰鸣。

    周身浮现天地异象，无尽苦海之上，涌现出璀璨的金色莲花。

    “这，这是……苦海种金莲！”

    “苦海种金莲，这是那种禁忌体质所独有的天地异象！”

    “荒古战体……”

    这一刻，祖地震动。

    五位老祖看到这般情形，心中五味杂陈。
content_en:
Not long after, Mu Ningwei was taken to the ancestral land of the Jiang family.

    She stared blankly at the five Shenyuan Mountains in front of her, with crumbs of cake still stuck to the corner of her mouth.

    "Jiang Wuhen, why did you bring me here? Are you trying to trick me into this deserted place and bully me again?" Mu Ningwei frowned and said warily, "I'm warning you, if mother can't find me, she will definitely ask you for someone else!"

    "Shut up and pay homage to our ancestor!"

    Jiang Wuhen reminded.

    "Ancestor?" Mu Ningwei looked around and asked doubtfully, "Is there anyone here except us?"

    "Xiao Wuhen, this girl... can you do it? Why does it feel like your head is not very bright?" The Third Ancestor was confused and worried, "Don't waste that Yuan Sheng Dan!"

    "Eh? The stone spoke!" Mu Ningwei was startled, turned around and wanted to leave, "What the hell is this place? Is it haunted?"

    "Mu Ningwei!" Jiang Wuhen glared at her and said in a deep voice, "The five ancestors of my Jiang family are sleeping here. Please show some respect! Otherwise, even if I tell your mother, she will teach you a lesson with me!"

    "You, you, you... don't scare me, my mother won't teach me a lesson!" Although Mu Ningwei was still tough, she stood beside Jiang Wuhen obediently, "Don't be so fierce, okay? I'll just listen to you."

    "That's pretty much it!"

    Jiang Wuhen took out the Yuan Sheng Dan and handed it to her, saying, "Keep it in your mouth and follow my orders before swallowing it!"

    "Oh."

    Mu Ningwei obeyed and put the Yuansheng Pill into her mouth.

    Jiang Wuhen looked at the five ancestors, and the ancestor said: "Let's get started..."

    "Swallow it!"

    Jiang Wuhen gave an order and Mu Ningwei swallowed the Yuan Sheng Dan.

    The next moment, a terrifying force exploded in her body.

    The powerful and domineering power roamed through her limbs and bones, cleansing her muscles and marrow.

    She is an innate fighting body born for fighting, and the process of sublimation is naturally much more violent than other divine bodies.

    "Jiang Wuhen, you big liar, you lied to me again..." Mu Ningwei knelt on the ground and struggled in pain, her voice hoarse, "It feels so uncomfortable, so painful..."

    Jiang Wuhen watched from the side without interfering.

    He knew in his heart that no one could help her at this time and she could only get through it on her own.

    After about ten breaths, the pain gradually subsided and was replaced by an indescribable sense of relief.

    White lights appeared on her body, and the blood flowing in her body made waves roar like a stormy sea.

    Visions of heaven and earth appeared around him, and bright golden lotus flowers emerged from the endless sea of ​​suffering.

    "This, this is...the golden lotus grown in the bitter sea!"

    "The golden lotus is planted in the sea of suffering. This is a vision of heaven and earth unique to that forbidden physique!"

    "Ancient battle body..."

    At this moment, the ancestral land shook.

    Seeing this situation, the five ancestors felt mixed emotions in their hearts.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 19 There is no great emperor in the human race, and the nine holy bodies fight against the sky!
